name: tube-bridge
description: Self-hosted YouTube research MCP with 17 tools for discovery, transcripts, frames, comments, and local semantic corpora.
long_description:
tube-bridge runs as a self-hosted local stdio MCP server. It does not use a hosted tube-bridge service or managed corpus storage; transcripts, vectors, and indexes remain on the machine running the bundle.

Fourteen of 17 tools work without a YouTube Data API key. ffmpeg remains an external system dependency and is needed only for youtube_get_frame. The local embedding model may download on first use; later embedding inference runs locally after its assets are available.

tools.name: youtube_search
tools.description: Search YouTube videos. Uses Data API v3 when YOUTUBE_API_KEY is set, falls back to yt-dlp. Filters: date range, channel, duration, order.

tools.name: youtube_search_channels
tools.description: Search YouTube channels by name/topic. Returns subscriber counts, video counts, country. Requires YOUTUBE_API_KEY.

tools.name: youtube_get_channel_info
tools.description: Detailed channel metadata: subscribers, views, videos, country, keywords. Requires YOUTUBE_API_KEY.

tools.name: youtube_get_video_info
tools.description: Detailed metadata for a YouTube video: title, duration, views, channel, description, tags.

tools.name: youtube_get_trending
tools.description: List up to `limit` currently trending YouTube videos. Use this for broad discovery, not keyword search. Read-only; uses Data API v3 when `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` is set and otherwise a keyless yt-dlp fallback. Returns source metadata and video records; results can change over time and depend on upstream availability.

tools.name: youtube_get_channel_videos
tools.description: List up to `limit` recent uploads from a known YouTube channel URL or @handle. Use this for channel browsing, not keyword search or channel metadata. Read-only and keyless; returns normalized channel metadata plus video records. Empty results include a warning when the channel is missing or has no uploads.

tools.name: youtube_get_playlist
tools.description: List up to `limit` videos from a known YouTube playlist URL in upstream order. Use this for playlist contents, not channel uploads or keyword search. Read-only and keyless; returns playlist metadata plus ordered video records. Results are bounded and may fail when the playlist is private, unavailable, or blocked upstream.

tools.name: youtube_get_transcript
tools.description: Transcript/subtitles of a YouTube video. Uses the original/default language; manual > ASR within that language.

tools.name: youtube_get_frame
tools.description: Extract one ephemeral JPEG near an integer-millisecond timestamp. Returns metadata plus MCP ImageContent; accuracy is best-effort at a decoded frame boundary.

tools.name: youtube_get_available_languages
tools.description: Available subtitle languages for a video. Shows manual vs auto-generated.

tools.name: youtube_get_comments
tools.description: Retrieve up to `max_results` top-level comments for a known YouTube video. Use this for audience reactions, not video metadata or transcripts. Read-only and requires `YOUTUBE_API_KEY`; returns structured comment records. Calls may fail when comments are disabled, the video is unavailable, or Data API quota is exhausted.

tools.name: corpus_create
tools.description: Create a named corpus for semantic search over transcripts. Each corpus uses a fixed embedding model.

tools.name: corpus_add
tools.description: Fetch a video's transcript, chunk it, and store local embeddings in an existing corpus. Use this after `corpus_create`; it skips an already-indexed video by default. `force_reembed=true` deletes and replaces that video's existing local chunks and vectors. This modifies local corpus data and may contact YouTube; returns indexing status and chunk count.

tools.name: corpus_search
tools.description: Semantic search within a corpus. Deduplicates overlapping windows, limits source domination, and returns titles plus timestamp URLs.

tools.name: corpus_list
tools.description: List all available corpora with chunk and video counts.

tools.name: corpus_delete
tools.description: Delete a corpus and all its chunks/vectors permanently.

tools.name: tube_bridge_help
tools.description: Get tube-bridge documentation: available tools, architecture, known limitations, API key setup.

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.title: YouTube Data API key (optional)
YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: Enables comments, channel search, channel details, and higher-quality Data API discovery.

TUBE_BRIDGE_PROXY.title: Proxy URL (optional)
TUBE_BRIDGE_PROXY.description: HTTP(S) or SOCKS proxy URL for yt-dlp and transcript requests.

TUBE_BRIDGE_CACHE.title: Local data directory
TUBE_BRIDGE_CACHE.description: Directory for the local response cache, corpus databases, vectors, and indexes.
